verdict.rationale: Column's own docs say it supports 'sweep' account types among the FDIC-insured accounts it can open via API. A community comment about a 'sweet'→'sweep' typo on the bank-accounts page also confirms that sweep is marketed. However, nothing in the pack describes interest earning, rate mechanics, or who keeps the spread, so this is only a glancing mention. Missing for 10: documented interest-bearing account terms, explanation of sweep mechanics and destinations, rate-setting or yield disclosure, spread/revenue-share disclosure, hands-on corroboration.
